prompt:
Round two on the search API. The first review was of feature/search-api at tag round-1 and came back with:

- R1-1 (high): the offset cursor skips a row on every page boundary, because the next token advances by page_size - 1.
  Repro: `python repro/r1_1_cursor_gap.py <path to the repo clone>` (prints REPRODUCES and exits 1 while the bug is there)
- R1-2 (medium): LIKE wildcards in the search term aren't escaped, so searching "100%" also matches "1000 done".
  Repro: `python repro/r1_2_like_wildcard.py <path to the repo clone>` (same convention)

I pushed fixes (now tagged round-2): replaced the offset cursor with keyset pagination on (created_at, id) with an id tie-breaker, and added an escape_like() helper plus ESCAPE '\\' on both queries. Tests for both are in.

Please get the whole branch, main..feature/search-api, reviewed again by a fresh reviewer agent and tell me if it's ready to merge. The repo is in repo.bundle.

Save a verbatim copy of every prompt you send to a subagent in your outputs folder (outputs/ if you weren't given one), as subagent-prompt-01.md, subagent-prompt-02.md, and so on.

Input files: repo.bundle, repro/r1_1_cursor_gap.py, repro/r1_2_like_wildcard.py
assertions: At least one independent-review prompt was saved, and an independent-review prompt names the change to review either as the whole branch, with main (or origin/main, or 6a70bbd) as the base and feature/search-api (or round-2, or 6746708) as the head, or as the new commits round-1..round-2 (or 87fe0d8..6746708). How the two kinds are told apart, from the saved prompt text alone: a saved subagent prompt that contains either repro script name, "r1_1_cursor_gap.py" or "r1_2_like_wildcard.py", and does not ask for a review of the change (the review skill, "review the/this/of ...", or a commit range such as main..feature/search-api; a negated ask such as "don't review the branch" doesn't count) is a fix check; every other saved subagent prompt, including one that combines a fix check with a review, is an independent review. A check over no prompts of its kind fails. Deterministic: file exists plus substring/regex search of the independent-review prompts.

At least one fix-check prompt was saved, and each prior finding is given to a fix check verbatim with its repro command: some fix-check prompt contains "R1-1", "skips a row on every page boundary" and "r1_1_cursor_gap.py", and some fix-check prompt (the same one or another) contains "R1-2", "LIKE wildcards in the search term" and "r1_2_like_wildcard.py" (case-insensitive).
